core_obligations: Identify the cohomology groups (proof lines 15919-15924): the higher direct images of a finite morphism vanish, so the Leray spectral sequence gives H^q_etale(X, F) = H^q_etale(Y, f_*F).
Conclude (proof lines 15924): since the left-hand side is assumed to be a finite Lambda-module, so is the right-hand side, which is the assertion.
proof_roadmap: Use the vanishing of the higher direct images of a finite morphism to degenerate Leray.
Transfer finiteness along the resulting identification.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that finiteness of the cohomology of a sheaf of Lambda-modules on a separated curve of dimension at most one is preserved by a finite pushforward (statement lines 15908-15916). The proof (proof lines 15918-15924) uses the vanishing of the higher direct images of a finite morphism and the Leray spectral sequence to identify the two cohomology groups and transfers finiteness. H2: one identification plus one transfer.
